Knees and feet stay on two distinct anatomical tracks, no crossed legs, twisted feet, wide splits, jumping, running, attack, high-knee portrait pose, or large sole facing viewer. Highest visual finish, clean alpha edges without purple/magenta fringe. Use Image4 established anatomical leg ownership. RIGHT NEAR boot is grounded beneath body and takes all weight, no lifting of that near-right foot. LEFT FAR knee bends mildly to pass; far-left boot hovers low20pixels above ground beside right support boot, slightly behind, on its own far-side track. This is opposite support to NE05.
